title: First Allagash sighting: sphere of light at Mud Pond
place_text: Mud Pond campsite, Chamberlain Lake, Allagash Waterway, Maine

tellings.quote: Uh, and a member of this other group said, "What the hell is that over there?" And we looked on the other side of the lake and here's this sphere of light and it's moving like a balloon moving very very slowly but it's like moving into this wind.

plain: In 1976, at the Mud Pond campsite on Chamberlain Lake in Maine's Allagash Waterway, a group of campers saw a sphere of light on the far side of the lake. It drifted very slowly, like a balloon, but against the wind. Charlie Foltz, who was there with another witness, Jim Weiner, tells Michels that someone from a nearby group called out "What the hell is that over there?", and that this was the first of the strange events of that trip.
